description: This file defines a controller class 'Coocook::Controller::Badge' in a Perl web application, specifically handling the generation of a 'dishes served' badge SVG image. It includes a method 'dishes_served' that calculates the total number of dishes served, formats the number with suffixes, creates a badge, and returns it as an SVG image.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Badge
classes.description: A controller class responsible for generating badge images related to dishes served in the application.

methods.name: dishes_served
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET and HEAD requests to generate an SVG badge showing the total number of dishes served, formatted with suffixes for large numbers.
